description: POST up to 50 identifiers. Validates IBAN (mod 97), EU/UK/CH/NO VAT format, EAN/UPC/ISBN check digits, card numbers (Luhn, brand), EVM addresses (EIP-55 checksum), Solana base58 addresses, email syntax and E.164 phone numbers. Type auto-detected when omitted. Returns normalized values. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].
